name: peribolos
description: Rule-enforced USDC spending vaults for AI agents on Arc.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @peribolos/core && npm run build -w @peribolos/langchain && npm run build -w @peribolos/dashboard
scripts.build:sdk: npm run build -w @peribolos/core && npm run build -w @peribolos/langchain
scripts.judge: npm run preflight && npm run demo:full
scripts.test: npm run test -w @peribolos/core && npm run test -w @peribolos/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @peribolos/core && npm run typecheck -w @peribolos/langchain && npm run typecheck -w @peribolos/dashboard && npm run typecheck -w @peribolos/demo-agent && npm run typecheck -w @peribolos/demo-seller && npm run typecheck -w @peribolos/api
